subject: Post-demo: POC next steps, success criteria & integration checkpoints
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Reilly <alex.reilly@nimblehealth.com>, Sarah Liao <sarah.liao@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Mar 2028 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: POC next steps, success criteria & integration checkpoints

Hi Alex / Sarah —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we don’t lose momentum. I’ve attached a short SOW draft and a requirements spreadsheet.

Demo recap (2 mins):
- Showed streaming embeddings + tool-calling flow for triage + auto-batching to hit 150ms median latency for common queries.
- Covered SDK live usage (node/python) and the /v1/stream and /v1/generate endpoints.
- Discussed security: VPC options, SOC2 artifacts, and token rotation via customer KMS.

Proposed POC success criteria (what we’ll measure):
1) Accuracy: >= 85% intent-match on the 200 sample prompts you supplied (evaluation harness).
2) Latency: median p99 < 300ms on streaming route under 50 RPS synthetic load.
3) Cost envelope: average token cost target < $0.002/token (we’ll provide cost breakdown).
4) Integration: SDK-based end-to-end flow (embedding -> rerank -> tool-calling) in your dev sandbox with automated test harness.

POC plan (high level):
- Week 0 (this week): finalize MAP and data access.
- Week 1: sandbox access + seed dataset ingest + initial integration using the Node SDK.
- Week 2: run acceptance test harness; iterate model/quantization profile.
- Week 3: acceptance review and decision.

Immediate asks from you:
1) Confirm which sandbox environment we should target (api.nimble-dev or your VPC) and provide any IP allowlist/ingress details.
2) Confirm whether you want streaming (SSE/Websocket) for the primary query path or simple HTTP generate.
3) Share procurement contact if you want a formal SOW/quote sent.

We can start a short mutual action plan (MAP) doc if you’re good with the above. Ben and Marissa are copied to own SDK support and success metrics. I’ll follow-up with an explicit MAP + timeline doc later today.

Attachments: nimble_poc_requirements.xlsx, redwood_trial_sow_v1.pdf

Thanks —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0193
https://redwood.ai
From: Alex Reilly <alex.reilly@nimblehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Liao <sarah.liao@nimblehealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Mar 2028 16:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: POC next steps, success criteria & integration checkpoints

Thanks Hannah — good summary. Quick clarifications from our side:

- Streaming: we prefer streaming for the primary query path (SSE or WebSocket) since we need progressive responses for long clinical notes.
- Traffic profile: typical dev traffic will be ~10 RPS, peak test up to 60 RPS. We can provide a small simulator.
- Data access: we will provision a dev sandbox (api.nimble-dev) and can generate API keys; our infra team will need to approve any IP allowlist.
- Compliance: please send SOC2 report + any FedRAMP or ISO artifacts you have. Also need confirmation on data retention policy for trial logs.

Procurement: looped in our procurement lead (procure@nimblehealth.com) on next steps. We’d like a one-page MAP + SOW to expedite approval. Target kickoff next Monday (Mar 27) if possible.

Alex
Alex Reilly
Product Lead | NimbleHealth
alex.reilly@nimblehealth.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Mar 2028 18:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo: POC next steps — internal assignment

Hannah / Marissa — forwarding the thread from Nimble. Action items I suggest we split:

- Marissa: lead SDK onboarding + streaming sample app. Deliverable: PR with sample Node/TS app that connects to /v1/stream and demonstrates function-calls. Target: Thu EOD (Mar 23).
- Ben (me): bench and cost profile under 10/60 RPS with current quantization profile; confirm autoscale behavior on Dedicated pools. Deliverable: bench report by Fri AM (Mar 24).
- Hannah: finalize MAP + SOW and own cadence with Nimble procurement.

Notes / technical constraints:
- Tool-calling: latest runtime supports JSON function-calls; we should include fallback to a non-streaming route for certain tool calls that require full context.
- If they go VPC, need to coordinate with infra for private endpoint.

I’ll spin up a small stress job tonight to validate p99.
-Ben
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Reilly <alex.reilly@nimblehealth.com>, Sarah Liao <sarah.liao@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, procure@nimblehealth.com
Date: Thu, 23 Mar 2028 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: POC one-pager: MAP, owners, endpoints, timeline (attached)

Alex / Sarah — attached is the one-page MAP and a cleaned-up SOW (redwood_trial_sow_v1.pdf). Below is the concise implementation plan we’ll execute if you confirm kickoff Monday:

POC one-liner: Validate streaming-based triage + tool-calling in your dev sandbox with 85%+ intent-match and p99 < 300ms under 50 RPS.

Owners:
- Redwood PM/Eng: Hannah Schmitt (POC cadence, success metrics)
- Redwood SDK/Platform: Marissa Cole (sample app + integration support)
- Redwood Performance: Ben Carter (benchmarks + autoscale validation)
- Nimble Dev Lead: Alex Reilly (sandbox access, ingestion of seed dataset)

Integration details (technical):
- Primary SDK: Node (recommended) + Python examples.
- Endpoints: /v1/stream (SSE) for progressive responses; /v1/generate for non-streaming fallbacks.
- Tool-calling: function-call JSON schema; we’ll ship a small adapter that maps function outputs to Nimble’s triage microservices.
- Auth: temporary API keys for sandbox; if VPC chosen, we’ll provide private endpoint instructions and KMS integration notes.

Evaluation plan & timeline:
- Day 0 (Mon): Kickoff + sandbox API key exchange.
- Days 1–3: SDK integration + seed data ingest. Run initial smoke tests.
- Day 4: Run acceptance harness against 200 eval prompts.
- Day 5: Review results and adjust model profile / quantization.

Deliverables: MAP doc, SOW (attached), SDK sample app repo link, bench summary.

Next steps for Nimble (please):
1) Reply with sandbox hostname (api.nimble-dev) confirmation and any IP allowlist window.
2) Approve MAP + procurement contact for SOW.
3) Confirm kickoff time on Mon (we propose 10:00am PT).

Link to shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-nimble-poc

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Hannah
From: Sarah Liao <sarah.liao@nimblehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Alex Reilly <alex.reilly@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, procure@nimblehealth.com
Date: Fri, 24 Mar 2028 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC one-pager: MAP, owners, endpoints, timeline (attached)

Thanks Hannah — the MAP looks good to us. Quick notes:

- Sandbox: confirmed api.nimble-dev. We’ll generate API keys and send them to Hannah via the secure portal this afternoon.
- Streaming: we want SSE for the first pass. If you can provide a short sample WebSocket/SSE app (Marissa to own), that would be ideal.
- Compliance: procurement asked for SOC2 and retention details — please send to procure@nimblehealth.com.
- Procurement contact: procure@nimblehealth.com (cc’d). They will expect a SOW + invoice to start the PO.

We approve kickoff Monday 10:00am PT. Alex will coordinate the invite.

Sarah
Sarah Liao
CTO | NimbleHealth
